reviews.title: My cats love these
reviews.body: My cats are completely obsessed with this wet cat food, i’ve been getting it for them for the past year or so and they love it. it comes in two portions so it’s perfect for my two cats I just grab one, break it down the middle and feed the perfect portion to each of them. it lasts quite a long time. I give them wet food once a day so it lasts around 24 days, which I think is good. not only do they love the taste of it but it’s genuinely good for them, I used to give them other cheaper brands but they were bad and made one of my cats gain a lot of weight, but this one is way healthier and better overall so I really recommend it.

reviews.author: Cary

reviews.title: Finally. The Humans Have Learned. 5/5 Paws Up!
reviews.body: Hello. I am the cat. I have opinions.Let me start by saying: this is acceptable. More than acceptable. This is elite dining.When my human peels back that little tray (very satisfying sound, by the way), I can immediately smell that it’s the good stuff. Real cuts. Actual gravy. Not that dry peasant kibble nonsense. The roasted chicken? Exquisite. The tender turkey? Refined. The salmon? A bold yet sustainable choice. I respect it.Now let’s discuss the perfect portions. No half-can leftovers shoved into the cold food cave (I’ve seen things). No sad, dried edges. Just fresh, sealed, nutritious and glorious servings every time. It’s as if the humans finally understand portion control… for me.The texture is excellent. Tender chunks swimming in gravy — easy to eat, highly lickable, bowl-cleaning worthy. I leave nothing behind. Not. A. Drop.And apparently this is a good value for the money — which is important because we now receive it on a subscription. Yes. A subscription. Because I have made it very clear that I cannot live without this. Dry food alone? Absolutely not. We’ve evolved past that.In conclusion, I will continue to scream at 6:00 AM for this meal specifically. And I expect it promptly.Sincerely,The "Potato" aka the Cat aka the Ruler of the House
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 19, 2026
reviews.author: Draco

reviews.title: Good for picky eaters
reviews.body: This is the only moist cat food my girls will eat so it's what I give them. I like the serving size as they only eat small amounts at a time so there's little to no waste. I don't love the packaging. When snapping it apart they often tear open so scissors are useful then they almost always leak upon peeling the lid back.
